Here's a job description. Map my experience onto it, and be straight about where I don't match.

Senior Revenue Operations Analyst — B2B data infrastructure company (Hybrid, Toronto or Remote in Canada)

About the role
We're a Series C company selling a usage-based data platform to mid-market and enterprise engineering teams. Our go-to-market organization has grown from 20 to 85 people in eighteen months, and the systems underneath it have not kept up. We're looking for a senior revenue operations analyst to own the reporting, forecasting and tooling that sales, customer success and finance leadership rely on every week. You'll report to the Director of Revenue Operations and work daily with the CRO, the VP of Finance and frontline sales managers across three regions.

What you'll do
- Own the weekly forecast call package: pipeline coverage, commit and best-case roll-ups, and slippage analysis by segment and region.
- Rebuild our quarter-end close reporting so bookings, ARR and commission inputs reconcile between Salesforce and NetSuite without a spreadsheet in the middle.
- Design and maintain executive dashboards for the CRO and the board deck, in Tableau today and possibly Looker after an evaluation next year.
- Partner with sales leadership to turn vague requests ("why is EMEA slipping?") into scoped analyses with a clear answer and a recommendation.
- Administer and improve Salesforce: opportunity stages, validation rules, flows, and the data model behind territories and account hierarchies.
- Build lightweight internal tools and automations that remove manual work from the deal desk, renewals and commission processes.
- Run territory and quota planning analysis with finance for the annual plan, including capacity models and ramp assumptions.
- Define and document the metrics the GTM organization runs on, and make sure every team calculates them the same way.
- Evaluate AI and LLM-based tooling for the revenue team, and ship the pieces that hold up in daily use.

Requirements
- 4+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, business operations or a similar analytical role at a B2B software company.
- Advanced SQL. You can write the query yourself rather than asking a data team for an extract.
- Hands-on experience with Salesforce reporting and administration; Salesforce Administrator certification preferred.
- Experience building dashboards in a BI tool such as Tableau, Looker or Power BI for an executive audience.
- Demonstrated ownership of a forecasting or quarter-end reporting process end to end.
- Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing models and how they change pipeline and revenue reporting.
- Familiarity with CPQ and billing systems (Salesforce CPQ, NetSuite, Zuora or similar).
- Experience with dbt and a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake or BigQuery.
- Strong written communication: you can explain a messy dataset to a CRO in three sentences.
- Comfortable automating your own work in Python, JavaScript, Apps Script or a low-code platform.

Nice to have
- Experience supporting a sales team through a pricing change or a CRM migration.
- Exposure to commission tooling such as CaptivateIQ, Spiff or Xactly.
- Experience at a company that grew past 100 GTM headcount.
- Prior experience managing or mentoring a junior analyst.
- French is an asset.

How we work
We're hybrid, with a Toronto office for anyone who wants it and two in-person planning weeks a year. We write things down: every recurring report has an owner, a definition and a changelog. You'll have real authority over the GTM systems roadmap, a budget for tooling, and a director who would rather you ship a working v1 than a perfect deck.

Compensation and benefits
The salary range for this role is CAD 105,000–125,000 plus equity, depending on experience. Benefits include health and dental coverage from day one, a learning budget, four weeks of vacation and a home-office stipend. We're unable to sponsor work permits for this role.
